title: Efficacy and Safety of Masitinib in Combination With SoC Versus Placebo in the Treatment of ALS Patients
content: ClinicalTrials.gov record for AB Science's confirmatory Phase 3 study (AB23005, NCT07174492) of masitinib 4.5 mg/kg/day in combination with riluzole versus placebo in ALS. Study targets normal progressors without complete loss of function (ALSFRS-R ≥1 on each item), enrolling 412 participants. Estimated start 2026, primary completion 2028.

title: AB Science Has Received Approval From Several European Countries to Initiate the Confirmatory Phase 3 Study of Masitinib in ALS
content: AB Science announced regulatory clearance from Spain, Greece, and Slovenia under the CTIS procedure and FDA authorization for the confirmatory Phase 3 study of masitinib in ALS. The study (AB23005) targets the subgroup of ALS patients with normal progression and without total loss of function, in which the prior Phase 2B/3 study (AB10015) showed a median survival increase of +12 months.

title: Ionis Well-Positioned for Continued Momentum and Substantial Value Creation in 2026
content: Ionis 2025 year-end update and 2026 outlook. Among partnered programs, lists results from the Phase 3 FUSION study of ulefnersen (ION363) for FUS-ALS as an anticipated 2026 milestone. Ionis and Otsuka are co-developing ulefnersen (previously called ION363).

title: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals Announces Formal Intention to Remove RELYVRIO®/ALBRIOZA™ from the Market
content: Amylyx announced voluntary withdrawal of RELYVRIO/ALBRIOZA (AMX0035, sodium phenylbutyrate and taurursodiol) from the US and Canadian markets following negative Phase 3 PHOENIX trial results. RELYVRIO had received FDA approval in September 2022. Patients currently on therapy were offered a free drug continuation program. Amylyx reduced workforce by ~70% and continues AMX0035 development in Wolfram syndrome and PSP, and AMX0114 in ALS.

title: FDA Grants Accelerated Approval for QALSODY™ (tofersen) for SOD1-ALS
content: FDA granted accelerated approval of QALSODY (tofersen 100 mg/15mL intrathecal injection) for ALS in adults with a SOD1 gene mutation, based on reduction in plasma neurofilament light chain (NfL). First approved treatment to target a genetic cause of ALS. Confirmatory approval contingent on results from the ongoing Phase 3 ATLAS study in presymptomatic SOD1 carriers. Discovered by Ionis, licensed to Biogen.

title: A Study of BIIB067 (Tofersen) Initiated in Clinically Presymptomatic Adults With a Confirmed Superoxide Dismutase 1 Mutation (ATLAS)
content: ClinicalTrials.gov record for the Phase 3 ATLAS study (NCT04856982) of tofersen in presymptomatic adults with a confirmed SOD1 mutation and elevated neurofilament. Randomized, placebo-controlled with open-label extension. Study started May 2021; 158 enrolled; estimated primary completion August 2027. Serves as the confirmatory trial for QALSODY's accelerated approval.

title: JAMA Neurology Publishes Long Term Results from the QALSODY Phase 3 VALOR Study and its Open-Label Extension in SOD1-ALS
content: Final 3.5-year results from the VALOR Phase 3 study and its OLE published in JAMA Neurology. Early initiation of QALSODY associated with numerically slower functional, respiratory, and strength decline vs. delayed initiation. 27% of early-start participants experienced improvements in muscle strength over ~3 years. Faster-progressing participants showed a 3.4-year extension of event-free survival with 6-month earlier start.

title: An Efficacy, Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics Study of BIIB067 (Tofersen) in Adults With Inherited Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) (VALOR)
content: ClinicalTrials.gov record for the Phase 3 VALOR study (NCT02623699, also known as study 233AS101) of tofersen (BIIB067) in adults with ALS and a confirmed superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) mutation. Three-part umbrella study: Part A (single ascending dose, Phase 1), Part B (multiple ascending dose, Phase 2), Part C (fixed dose, Phase 3 efficacy). Study started January 20, 2016; completed July 16, 2021. Total enrollment: 176 participants; 108 enrolled in Part C. Primary objective of Parts A and B: safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics (PK) of ascending doses; secondary objective: effects on cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) total SOD1 protein levels. Primary objective of Part C: evaluate clinical efficacy of tofersen vs. placebo in adults with ALS and confirmed SOD1 mutation. Secondary objectives of Part C: safety, tolerability, pharmacodynamic (PD), and biomarker effects of tofersen.

title: Efficacy and Safety of MSC-NTF (NurOwn) in Participants With Early Symptomatic ALS and Moderate Disease Presentation in ALS (ENDURANCE STUDY)
content: ClinicalTrials.gov record for the Phase 3b ENDURANCE study (NCT06973629) of NurOwn (debamestrocel, autologous MSC-NTF cells) in early symptomatic ALS. Two-part study: 24-week randomized double-blind placebo-controlled (Part A) then 24-week open-label extension (Part B). Enrolling ~200 participants, intrathecal administration every 8 weeks. Estimated start June 2025, primary completion November 2028.

title: BrainStorm Receives FDA Clearance to Initiate Phase 3b Trial of NurOwn® for ALS
content: BrainStorm announced FDA clearance to initiate the Phase 3b NurOwn ALS trial. Trial design was agreed upon under a Special Protocol Assessment (SPA), confirming endpoints and statistical methodology are appropriate to support a future BLA submission. Primary endpoint is change from baseline to week 24 in ALSFRS-R. ~200 participants to be enrolled at leading academic medical centers.

title: Clene Issues Stockholder Letter Highlighting Upcoming CNM-Au8® 2026 Catalysts
content: Clene outlined 2026 milestones for CNM-Au8 (oral gold nanocrystal suspension) in ALS: in-person Type C FDA meeting by end of Q1 2026, NDA submission via accelerated approval pathway in Q2 2026, potential PDUFA date in H2 2026. NDA is supported by data showing prolonged survival, reductions in NfL and GFAP biomarkers, and no CNM-Au8-related serious adverse events across 1,000+ patient-years of treatment. Confirmatory Phase 3 RESTORE-ALS trial planned to begin later in 2026.

title: FUSION: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of ION363 in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Participants With Fused in Sarcoma Mutations (FUS-ALS)
content: ClinicalTrials.gov record for the Phase 1-3 FUSION study (NCT04768972) of ulefnersen (ION363) in FUS-ALS. Three-part study: Part 1 is a 60-week randomized 2:1 placebo-controlled phase; Part 2 is 84 weeks open-label; Part 3 is up to 3 additional years. 89 participants enrolled. Estimated primary completion June 2026, study completion March 2028. Intrathecal administration. Sponsored by Ionis, partnered with Otsuka.

title: NeuroSense to Hold Pre-NDS Meeting with Health Canada in April 2026
content: NeuroSense announced a pre-NDS meeting with Health Canada scheduled for April 2026 for PrimeC in ALS. PrimeC is an oral fixed-dose combination of ciprofloxacin and celecoxib designed to target multiple ALS mechanisms. A potential New Drug Submission (NDS) to Health Canada is anticipated by mid-2026 pending a successful meeting outcome.

title: Pridopidine Phase 3 Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety in ALS (PREVAiLS)
content: ClinicalTrials.gov record for the Phase 3 PREVAiLS study (NCT07322003) of pridopidine 45 mg twice daily in adults with early, rapidly progressive ALS. 48-week double-blind placebo-controlled (3:2 randomization) followed by 48-week open-label extension. Primary endpoint is ALSFRS-R change from baseline at 48 weeks. Enrolling 500 participants. Study started February 2026, estimated primary completion March 2028. Sponsored by Prilenia.

title: Prilenia and Ferrer Announce FDA Clearance to Start the 'PREVAiLS' Pivotal Phase 3 Study with Pridopidine in ALS
content: Prilenia and Ferrer announced FDA clearance for the 500-patient PREVAiLS Phase 3 study of pridopidine in rapidly progressive early ALS. Study is predicated on Phase 2 HEALEY ALS Platform Trial subgroup data showing 32% slowing of overall progression, 57% improvement in survival, and improvements across respiratory and speech domains in 284 patients with rapidly progressive ALS. US recruitment began early 2026 across up to 60 ALS centers globally.

title: Ulefnersen Orphan Drug Designation for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
organization: FDA Office of Orphan Products Development
content: FDA Office of Orphan Products Development (OOPD) listing for ulefnersen. Orphan Drug Designation granted August 15, 2023 for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Sponsor: Ionis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Not yet FDA approved for orphan indication as of date of listing.

title: ION363 (Ulefnersen) FUSION Trial Overview and Protocol Amendment
content: MND Association clinical trial page for the FUSION study of ION363 (ulefnersen). Documents a May 2022 protocol amendment extending the double-blind phase from 29 weeks to 61 weeks to increase the likelihood of detecting a clinically meaningful signal.

title: Ionis Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results and Highlights Progress on Key Programs
content: Ionis full-year 2025 financial results and corporate update, published February 25, 2026. Lists the FDA Fast Track designation granted to ulefnersen for the treatment of FUS-ALS as a 2025 achievement under Partnered Medicines highlights. FUSION Phase 3 data readout is listed as a Key Phase 3 Clinical Event anticipated in 2026.

title: NeuroSense Receives FDA Clearance to Initiate Pivotal Phase 3 Trial for PrimeC in ALS
content: NeuroSense announced FDA clearance of its Investigational New Drug (IND) amendment to initiate PARAGON, the pivotal Phase 3 trial of PrimeC in ALS. PARAGON is a prospective, randomized (2:1), double-blind, 12-month placebo-controlled trial with an open-label extension, enrolling 300 participants across the U.S. and EU. Adaptive design with interim analyses. Powered at over 95% to achieve its primary endpoint. Trial initiation pending NeuroSense securing necessary strategic resources.
